description: Instantly mint a free evaluation API key in-band — no HTTP detour required. The key grants 50 calls/day per lane plus limited write-beta access and is issued anonymously (one per client IP per UTC day, global daily issuance cap). Pass the returned token as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' on subsequent calls.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).

ref.description: Optional referral/channel tag for issuance attribution (max 64 chars, sanitized).
